_note: Compass Rose Runways (prefix cr.). Speakers: ziggy (host, in the tower), gloop (helper), narrator (story). Numbers are spoken digit by digit, the way a tower says them (runway two seven, wind two four zero). See docs/worlds/compass-runways.md.

cr.ready.text: Hi, I'm Ziggy, up in the tower. Ready to help me run the runways?
cr.ready.speaker: ziggy

cr.back.text: Welcome back to the tower. More planes are on the way.
cr.back.speaker: ziggy

cr.story.intro1.text: Last night, a wild storm blew across Sky School Airport.
cr.story.intro1.speaker: narrator

cr.story.intro2.text: Oh dear. The wind carried off every runway sign and number!
cr.story.intro2.speaker: ziggy

cr.story.intro3.text: And the first planes are already flying in.
cr.story.intro3.speaker: narrator

cr.story.intro4.text: Read the wind with me, and paint the runways before they land.
cr.story.intro4.speaker: ziggy

cr.story.between2.text: Two jobs done. The first plane is lining up.
cr.story.between2.speaker: ziggy

cr.story.between4.text: Halfway there. Keep an eye on that windsock.
cr.story.between4.speaker: ziggy

cr.story.between6.text: Two more, and every plane can come down.
cr.story.between6.speaker: ziggy

cr.story.outro1.text: One by one, every plane touched down safely.
cr.story.outro1.speaker: narrator

cr.story.outro2.text: You read the wind, worked out headings and painted every number.
cr.story.outro2.speaker: ziggy

cr.story.outro3.text: Here's your Compass Rose Pin. Welcome to the tower crew!
cr.story.outro3.speaker: ziggy

cr.prompt.tutorial.text: The sock points west, so the wind comes from the east. Tap East!
cr.prompt.tutorial.speaker: ziggy

cr.prompt.strength.text: How strong is the wind? Read the windsock.
cr.prompt.strength.speaker: ziggy

cr.prompt.from.text: Read the windsock. Where is the wind coming from?
cr.prompt.from.speaker: ziggy

cr.prompt.fromDeg.text: Read the sock on the compass rose. Which heading is the wind coming from?
cr.prompt.fromDeg.speaker: ziggy

cr.prompt.paint.text: Which number gets painted on this runway end?
cr.prompt.paint.speaker: ziggy

cr.prompt.opp.text: This end is runway {rw}. Paint the number on the other end.
cr.prompt.opp.speaker: ziggy

cr.prompt.rotate.text: Turn the runway until its arrow end is runway {rw}.
cr.prompt.rotate.speaker: ziggy

cr.prompt.turn.text: Turn {dir} {deg} degrees. What's your new heading?
cr.prompt.turn.speaker: ziggy

cr.prompt.land.text: Which runway end should this plane land on?
cr.prompt.land.speaker: ziggy

cr.prompt.xwind.text: Compare the wind with the runway. What will the plane feel?
cr.prompt.xwind.speaker: ziggy

cr.tower.wind.text: Tower here. Wind {wind} at one zero. Which runway?
cr.tower.wind.speaker: ziggy

cr.tower.line.text: Cleared to land, runway {rw}. What heading will you fly?
cr.tower.line.speaker: ziggy

cr.tower.join.text: Tower here. Follow my turn. Which runway is straight ahead?
cr.tower.join.speaker: ziggy

cr.tower.comp.text: Tower here. Wind {wind} at one zero. What wind will you feel?
cr.tower.comp.speaker: ziggy

cr.idle.text: Take your time. The compass rose has every clue you need.
cr.idle.speaker: ziggy

cr.help.strength.text: A limp windsock means calm. The fuller and straighter it flies, the stronger the wind.
cr.help.strength.speaker: gloop

cr.help.from.text: A windsock is like a tail. It points away from where the wind comes from.
cr.help.from.speaker: gloop

cr.help.fromDeg.text: Find where the sock points, then look the opposite way on the rose.
cr.help.fromDeg.speaker: gloop

cr.help.paint.text: Take the heading and drop the last zero. Heading two seven zero is runway two seven.
cr.help.paint.speaker: gloop

cr.help.round.text: Round the heading to the nearest ten first, then drop the zero.
cr.help.round.speaker: gloop

cr.help.opp.text: The two ends face opposite ways, so their numbers are eighteen apart.
cr.help.opp.speaker: gloop

cr.help.rotate.text: Runway numbers are headings without the last zero. Put the zero back to aim the arrow.
cr.help.rotate.speaker: gloop

cr.help.turn.text: Turning right adds degrees. Turning left takes them away.
cr.help.turn.speaker: gloop

cr.help.wrap.text: Going right past north? Add the turn, then take away three hundred sixty.
cr.help.wrap.speaker: gloop

cr.help.wrapLeft.text: Going left past north? Add three hundred sixty first, then take the turn away.
cr.help.wrapLeft.speaker: gloop

cr.help.land.text: Planes land into the wind. Choose the end that faces where the wind comes from.
cr.help.land.speaker: gloop

cr.help.xwind.text: Wind straight down the runway is a headwind. Wind across it is a crosswind.
cr.help.xwind.speaker: gloop

cr.help.tower.text: Take the call one step at a time. Find the number first, then what it means.
cr.help.tower.speaker: gloop

cr.hint.toWind.text: That's where the wind is going. Name the side it comes from.
cr.hint.toWind.speaker: gloop

cr.hint.mouth.text: Find the sock's wide, open end. The wind blows into it.
cr.hint.mouth.speaker: gloop

cr.hint.ticks.text: Check the marks on the rose. Each big mark is thirty degrees.
cr.hint.ticks.speaker: gloop

cr.hint.recip.text: That number belongs to the other end. Follow the landing arrow.
cr.hint.recip.speaker: gloop

cr.hint.roundCheck.text: Nearly! Is the heading closer to the ten above, or the ten below?
cr.hint.roundCheck.speaker: gloop

cr.hint.oppSame.text: Each end gets its own number. The other end faces the opposite way.
cr.hint.oppSame.speaker: gloop

cr.hint.flip.text: That lines up the other end. Swing the arrow end round the other way.
cr.hint.flip.speaker: gloop

cr.hint.addZero.text: Runway numbers are headings with the last zero dropped. Put the zero back.
cr.hint.addZero.speaker: gloop

cr.hint.turnWay.text: Check the direction. Right turns go clockwise, like a clock's hands.
cr.hint.turnWay.speaker: gloop

cr.hint.over360.text: You added the turn carefully! Past three hundred sixty, take three hundred sixty away.
cr.hint.over360.speaker: gloop

cr.hint.under0.text: You took the turn away carefully! Below zero, add three hundred sixty to come round.
cr.hint.under0.speaker: gloop

cr.hint.tail.text: Landing that way, the wind would push from behind. Turn round and face it.
cr.hint.tail.speaker: gloop

cr.hint.side.text: That runway is side-on to the wind. Find the end that faces it best.
cr.hint.side.speaker: gloop

cr.hint.across.text: Is the wind blowing along the runway, or across it from the side?
cr.hint.across.speaker: gloop

cr.hint.along.text: Look again. Is the wind in line with the runway, or across it?
cr.hint.along.speaker: gloop

cr.hint.frontBack.text: Is the wind blowing into the plane's nose, or from behind its tail?
cr.hint.frontBack.speaker: gloop

cr.hint.lineRecip.text: That's the other end's heading. Just add a zero to the runway number.
cr.hint.lineRecip.speaker: gloop

cr.hint.steps.text: First work out the new heading. Then find the runway that matches it.
cr.hint.steps.speaker: gloop

cr.hint.model.text: Here's the working. Follow it on the board.
cr.hint.model.speaker: ziggy

cr.hint.show.text: See the glowing answer? Work out why it fits.
cr.hint.show.speaker: ziggy

cr.praise.strength.text: You read how full the windsock was.
cr.praise.strength.speaker: ziggy

cr.praise.from.text: Yes! You named the wind by where it comes from.
cr.praise.from.speaker: ziggy

cr.praise.from2.text: Spot on. You looked past where the sock was pointing.
cr.praise.from2.speaker: ziggy

cr.praise.fromDeg.text: You read the sock against the compass rose.
cr.praise.fromDeg.speaker: ziggy

cr.praise.paint.text: Heading divided by ten. Fresh paint on the runway!
cr.praise.paint.speaker: ziggy

cr.praise.round.text: You rounded to the nearest ten first. Neat painting!
cr.praise.round.speaker: ziggy

cr.praise.opp.text: You used the eighteen rule for the other end.
cr.praise.opp.speaker: ziggy

cr.praise.rotate.text: You turned the runway to match its number.
cr.praise.rotate.speaker: ziggy

cr.praise.turnRight.text: A right turn, so you added degrees. On heading!
cr.praise.turnRight.speaker: ziggy

cr.praise.turnLeft.text: A left turn, so you took degrees away. On heading!
cr.praise.turnLeft.speaker: ziggy

cr.praise.wrap.text: You went past north and kept counting round the circle.
cr.praise.wrap.speaker: ziggy

cr.praise.land.text: Into the wind. That headwind means a slower, shorter landing.
cr.praise.land.speaker: ziggy

cr.praise.land2.text: You matched the runway to the wind. Smooth landing!
cr.praise.land2.speaker: ziggy

cr.praise.xwind.text: You compared the wind with the runway's heading.
cr.praise.xwind.speaker: ziggy

cr.praise.twind.text: You turned the tower's wind call into a runway.
cr.praise.twind.speaker: ziggy

cr.praise.tline.text: You turned the runway number back into a heading.
cr.praise.tline.speaker: ziggy

cr.praise.tjoin.text: Turn first, then match the runway. Lined up!
cr.praise.tjoin.speaker: ziggy
